behavior: Freelancer and merchant profiles create, list and open invoices in the dashboard
acceptance: R-44: the Invoices page creates an invoice (USDC amount, title, note, due date, checkout expiry, client name, email and address), lists number, client, amount, status and due date, and opens a detail page with a status timeline and the share link with a copy button; the sidebar item is no longer Soon

R-44: a unit test turns typed amounts (1, 0.000001, 1234.56) into exact base units without float and rejects 7 decimals and 0; Playwright covers create, list and detail on desktop and phone; axe finds 0 serious or critical violations
notes: 2026-10-10 review pass by reviewer: R-44 met. Money exact: parseTokenAmount is bigint-only, rejects 0/negative/7 decimals/commas/junk; API gets base-unit strings; exactDigits keeps every non-zero digit. Idempotency key per JSON of form values (retry reuses, changed form gets new key; form keyed by profile). RTK Query injectEndpoints with profileId in args, Invoices tag invalidated by create, infinite query cursor correct. Labels, aria-invalid/aria-describedby, timeline list with aria-current, copy status, axe on all pages, 390px scroll checks. Structure follows structure.md; activity dependency named in architecture.md; TextAreaField on /kit with hint and error. Reviewer fix: the form now moves focus to the invalid field on a client or 422 error (flushSync + focus), e2e asserts it; verify re-run passed. Known follow-up F100 (one-item list read). Minor, not blocking: Party uses line text as React key; invoices screen fetches balances for a personal profile.

proof.1: e2e: the live Privy test (e2e/privy/sign-in.spec.ts) opens Invoices from the merchant sidebar (a link, not Soon), creates an invoice with amount, title, note, due date, checkout expiry and client name, email and address, opens its detail (number, amount in USDC, status timeline, due date apart from checkout close, client, /pay link copied whole) and finds it in the list with number, client, amount, status and due date
proof.2: unit: features/invoices/invoices.test.ts turns 1, 0.000001 and 1234.56 into exact base units with bigint and rejects 7 decimals, 0, negatives and junk; e2e: create, list and detail on desktop and on a 390px phone (dark) with no sideways scroll, axe 0 serious or critical on the list, form, form error, detail and phone pages
